achievements.name: Intro Clear
achievements.detail: Solve every puzzle in the Intro world.

achievements.name: Enter a Box
achievements.detail: Solve a puzzle that requires stepping inside a box.

achievements.name: Red Challenge
achievements.detail: Clear a challenge puzzle outlined in red.

achievements.name: Blue Side
achievements.detail: Clear an optional side puzzle outlined in blue.

achievements.name: Clone World
achievements.detail: Solve a puzzle in the Clone world.

achievements.name: Reference
achievements.detail: Solve a puzzle in the Reference world, where boxes contain one another.

achievements.name: Infinite Exit
achievements.detail: Clear enough of Infinite Exit for the path to continue.

achievements.name: Mainline End
achievements.detail: Clear enough of Multi Infinite to finish the main path.

achievements.name: Reception
achievements.detail: Enter Reception after the mainline worlds are finished.

achievements.name: Challenge Set
achievements.detail: Clear a puzzle in the postgame Challenge world.

achievements.name: Gallery
achievements.detail: Clear a Gallery puzzle shown in the game's early prototype graphics.

achievements.name: Appendix
achievements.detail: Clear a puzzle in an Appendix world, where a movement rule is changed.

achievements.name: Every Puzzle
achievements.detail: Solve every puzzle, including the postgame sets.
